findings.failure_path: For frontmatter containing an empty or whitespace-only first `name:` followed by another `name: retired-skill`, awk stops at the first field and returns empty. The new regex requires a non-whitespace character, skips that field, and returns the later name. This changes recognition from rejected to accepted, violating the documented first-name contract at the directory-retirement boundary.
findings.smallest_fix: Match the first name field even when empty, trim its value, and return immediately. Add fixtures for empty and whitespace-only first names followed by a recognized name.

findings.failure_path: With pipefail enabled, grep -q can find a matching blob and close the pipe while git is still emitting a sufficiently large history. Git can then exit on SIGPIPE, making shipped_skill_md report failure despite a match. The previous awk drained the stream. The packet omits shell options, so applicability to the installer cannot be resolved.
findings.smallest_fix: Drain the stream with `grep -F -- " $blob " >/dev/null` instead of grep -q, and verify a matching blob with history exceeding the pipe buffer under pipefail.
